data.exact_reserve_text: During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes, $7.4m of reserves were released in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding opened at 225.9 (USD millions). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates net favourable prior-year development of approximately 29.1m (USD) across underwriting years 2018-2021 (a release). The managing agent also reports a prospective change of estimate driven by a refinement of actuarial methodology and risk margin, which produced a net release of $7.4m (net of reinsurance). The movement is therefore primarily driven by reserve methodology changes and favourable claims development, with climate-related events (e.g. Hurricane Ian and Storm Elliot) noted as impacting 2022 but the overall prior-year movement being a release.
